headline: Colonial Gains Mount in Nevish Line as Stlican Shelf Crumbles
war_summary: Colonial forces have pressed their advantage in Nevish Line over the past three hours, seizing a third strategic position against five Warden redoubts as fierce combat churns around Blackcoat Way and Princefal. Across the eastern sector, instability has deepened in Stlican Shelf, where two positions now lie battered in no-man's-land and six clashes erupted over the past two hours near Fort Hoarfrost and Breaker Town. Weathered Expanse endures as the theater's bloodiest crucible, where casualty rates surged again to more than two thousand combined losses in the latest hour alone amidst ceaseless swings around Crow's Nest and Frostmarch. Further west, Mooring County has abruptly flared into intense bloodshed with new enlistments and casualty rates accelerating markedly, though Warden control remains unbroken. In Callahan's Passage, the Colonial bridgehead holds steady at two bases amidst mounting frontline butcher's bills, while earlier hotspots in Linn of Mercy and Stonecradle have largely fallen silent following the morning's heavy exchanges.
